locations.title: Locations
locations.description: One entry per place to monitor. 'mode' = 'own' routes through Groq analysis + notifications; anything else (e.g. 'competitor') is logged raw. For competitors put the competitor's name in 'branch'.

webhookUrl.title: n8n webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: Production webhook URL of the n8n workflow, e.g. https://your-n8n/webhook/new-review

maxReviewsPerRun.title: Max reviews per location per run
maxReviewsPerRun.description: How many newest reviews to load/check each run. Must be high enough that already-logged reviews are re-checked for amendments / owner replies.

timezoneOffsetHours.title: Timezone offset from UTC (hours)
timezoneOffsetHours.description: Applied to the Logged At / Last Updated At timestamps. Apify runs in UTC; set 4 for Gulf Standard Time (UAE).

googleCookies.title: Google session cookies (optional)
googleCookies.description: Playwright-format cookies from a signed-in Google session. Supply these (or use a residential proxy) if Google serves a 'limited view' with no reviews. Export with a 'Get cookies.txt'-style extension and convert to Playwright JSON.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy. Residential proxies are recommended to avoid Google's automation gate.
